title: Third Treaty of San Ildefonso
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Third Treaty of San Ildefonso", at revision 1378545877, opens: "The Third Treaty of San Ildefonso was a secret agreement signed on 1 October 1800 between Spain and the French Republic by which Spain agreed in principle to exchange its North American colony of Louisiana for territories in Tuscany. The terms were later confirmed by the March 1801 Treaty of Aranjuez." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1259275, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty between France and Spain involving the colonial territory of Louisiana". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
